title: attack
summary: MSUI implements the complete current Benilla melee wire: attack start/stop, attacker-state sub-damage folding, attack swing/stop writers, swing-error messages, and strict SMSG_AI_REACTION decoding. AI alert/hostile reactions resolve CreatureDisplayInfo.SoundID with CreatureModelData fallback, select CreatureSoundData alert/aggro kits, play positionally, redirect mounted alerts, and latch hostile one-shots against overlap.

openItems.text: SMSG_AI_REACTION: opcode-table entry only (Net/Opcodes.cs:290), no handler in the Program.Net.cs dispatch - the creature aggro/alert notice (raw u64 guid + u32 reaction) is never parsed
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: added strict raw-u64/u32 parsing, live dispatch, display/model-fallback CreatureSoundData lookup, alert/aggro positional playback, mounted-alert redirect, hostile one-shot latching, and focused clinical coverage.
